_comment:
'At the beginning of your end phase, put a -1{d} counter on this.' / 'Blade Break'

BladeBreak is a printed keyword (printed_keywords) and fires from the card DB keywords field - deliberately NOT authored.

UPKEEP TRIGGER: BEGINNING_OF_END_PHASE is dispatched to BOTH players' permanent zones at EITHER hero's end phase (engine.py:1495-1503, _dsl_permanent_zones includes player.arms), so release note 1 ('only ... your end phase, not your opponent's') is carried by IS_ACTIVE_PLAYER value:true (condition_types.py:811-821: controller == active_player) -- the same gating as .drafts/burn_them_all_red.json. PUT_COUNTER (effect_types.py:2015-2058) reads counter_type/amount/target and defaults to the SOURCE card when no target is given (line 2031) = 'on this'. counter_type 'minus_defense' is in DEFENSE_COUNTER_KINDS (ability_keywords.py:211), so it routes through _apply_defense_counter and actually reduces {d} on recalc instead of being inert bookkeeping.

RELEASE NOTE 2 ('if this has 3 or more -1{d} counters, its defense value is 0, and does not become negative'): printed {d} is 2 (card DB), so plain per-counter reduction reaches 0 at two counters and would go NEGATIVE from the third onward -- _apply_defense_counter's immediate update (ability_keywords.py:252-253) and the recalc reset (engine.py:2053) both compute base - counters with no floor. The second ability clamps exactly that case: a WHILE_STATIC naming trigger RECALC_DEFENSE runs only on the defence recalculation (interpreter.py:186-202); IS_DEFENDING_CARD scopes it to the defender currently being evaluated (without it the dispatch reaches this equipment once per EVERY defender and would zero other cards), and COUNTER_GTE reads the card's own minus_defense tally (condition_types.py:998-1030). MODIFY_DEFENSE mod:'set' amount 0 targets combat.defense_recalc_card during recalc and floors at 0 (effect_types.py:2708-2709). With fewer than 3 counters the static is inert and reduction is exact (2-n >= 0), so max(0, 2-n) holds for every count.

FLAGGED APPROXIMATION: between combats card.defense can read negative (the immediate update in _apply_defense_counter is unfloored); the authoritative value used when defending is the recalc, which this static corrects. A general max(0, base - counters) expression does not exist (no MAX/BASE_DEFENSE amount forms for DEFENSE_EQUALS), hence the threshold-shaped clamp.
